title: policy.json: store
description: The private store's remote (design 0003, section 11). Only whether this project needs one is committed. The address and the device list never go in the project's repository, which may be public: the address comes from HITLD_STORE_REMOTE (a cloud environment) or the person file (hitld store remote set), and the device list is on the hitld-devices branch of the store repository. store.remote.url is refused, with a message saying where the address goes.

remote.description: The private store's remote: where its encrypted bundles are kept between machines.

required.description: Whether this project expects a store remote on every machine and session. When true and no address is found, hitld run start, hitld run resume and hitld store status say so, naming HITLD_STORE_REMOTE and hitld store remote set, and the session hooks print one line. Nothing is refused: work goes on with the local store.
